storyline.real: Häkkinen leads the first stint. Light rain falls from lap 30; at the second stops Ferrari keep Schumacher out longer, and he comes out ahead and wins by 1.8 s, which makes him champion.
storyline.headline: Häkkinen holds Suzuka and takes the title to the last race

eras.briefing: Suzuka, 2000. Schumacher on pole, Häkkinen beside him; a Schumacher win settles the title. You run Häkkinen, leading by 2.7 s after 19 laps. Keep Schumacher behind to the flag.
